tools.description:
Estimate the cost of one or more home-improvement services for a US home.

    When to use: the homeowner wants to know what a job should cost, for
    example before asking contractors for bids.

    estimate from national cost

tools.name: compare_tiers
tools.description:
Price the same project at economy, mid-range and premium quality side by side.

    When to use: the homeowner asks "what's the difference between a basic and a
    high-end job?" or wants to choose a budget level.
